Decision-Making FAQs

Direct answers regarding architecture, data privacy, and ROI timelines.

We implement a pragmatic hybrid AI architecture. For confidential customer data, internal contracts, and sensitive trade secrets, we deploy open-weight models (Llama 3, Mistral) on private client-controlled servers where data never leaves your perimeter and token costs remain $0.00 USD. When tasks require state-of-the-art complex reasoning, multimodal processing, or elastic throughput, we seamlessly orchestrate leading commercial APIs (such as OpenAI or Anthropic) using sanitization layers and zero-data-retention enterprise controls.

WordPress monoliths suffer from technical debt, plugin vulnerabilities, and slow server response times over 900ms. Soluvirtus engineers decoupled web apps using Astro, Next.js, and Supabase (with Row-Level Security). This delivers sub-150ms Edge load speeds, bulletproof security, and native flexibility to orchestrate autonomous AI agents.

Unlike rigid no-code workflows that break whenever web layouts or document formats change, an Agent-First system leverages AI models that can reason, interpret unstructured documents, make conditional decisions, and handle complex business logic autonomously.

It means features are not considered finished without automated verification. We write automated integration suites with Pytest to test API logic and E2E browser tests with Selenium for critical checkout and lead workflows. This ensures software releases are production-hardened without costly downtime.

An initial high-impact automation or scraper pipeline is typically deployed within 2 to 3 weeks. Most of our clients recoup 100% of their investment within 60 to 90 days by reclaiming up to 70% of the operational hours previously lost to manual processing.

We build with a modern, high-speed, secure stack: Astro and Next.js with React for lightning-fast UIs; Tailwind CSS for responsive styling; Python (PyMuPDF, Pytest, Selenium) for automation and data extraction; and Supabase (PostgreSQL) with Row-Level Security (RLS) for data governance.

All deliverables are 100% documented and owned by you. We also provide monthly retainer options that include proactive agent performance monitoring, prompt engineering optimization, local model version upgrades, and scraper adaptations against external site layout changes.
